doc: Universe 002 router (DESIGN-002 §2). Evaluated in order, first match wins; predicates are a fixed vocabulary interpreted by lanes.ts (no model call). Nothing matched → main (= today's behaviour).

notify.doc: Spec v3, stricter option (design/notify.md 「分級由分流器依訊息類型決定，不靠各條線自己判斷」; genesis/conditions 「依事件類別，以及車道有沒有用『升級』」). The router alone sets the tier of every lane message to Joey: classes[<event class>][plain|escalated]. Event class = the routing rule's trigger (rules[].trigger; -critical / -info when critical_regex / info_regex match); lanes opened by the main get their lane kind (worker, fork); a reflex lane without a trigger = 'other' → default. 'escalated' = the lane called escalate() earlier in the same run; an escalated run that sent no push gets the escalation text pushed by the router at exit (exactly one push). Lanes declare nothing (notify_joey(text) has no tier/kind argument). no_reply notices never reach a lane: rule mesh-no-reply → ledger, no session. The main's own messages are not routed here.

joey.why: reply to a Joey-originated request (Joey quoted a lane message / wrote in a worker topic)

worker.why: worker lane opened by the main (open_worker) in Joey's DM topic: its reports answer the request the main delegated (not named in spec v3; classified as a Joey-originated request)

peer.why: peer agent's new topic: peer result

thread.why: peer reply in a lane's thread: peer result, unless it answers a question the lane asked while serving another class (then that class, e.g. joey → push)

alert.why: non-critical alert (P2/warning, unmarked): routine alert 例行警報

fork.why: fork lane opened by the main: its result also reaches the main's digest

no_reply.why: no_reply notice: ledger only, no session (rule mesh-no-reply)

limits.doc: 「分流器同時管頻率上限與去重」: ≤1 push per thread per 10 min, further pushes go silent; escalated runs and replies to Joey are exempt (the cap is for machine-originated repeats); the same text from the same thread within 10 min is suppressed.
